name: 01_free_space
title: 1D free-space pulse with zero exterior ghosts
notes: Corrected last-cell index from sin_nada_modi. Zero ghosts reflect; they are not an absorbing boundary. Uses 532 nm and dx=lambda/10 from the thesis prose (printed p. 43), rather than the MATLAB draft wavelength.

name: 02_absorbing_boundary
title: 1D pulse with the thesis delay ABC
notes: The thesis calls this PEC. It is a two-step delay absorbing boundary at S=0.5. Uses 532 nm and dx=lambda/10 from the thesis prose (printed p. 43), rather than the MATLAB draft wavelength.

name: 03_tfsf_pulse
title: 1D one-way TF/SF pulse
notes: Uses 532 nm and dx=lambda/10 from the thesis prose (printed p. 43), rather than the MATLAB draft wavelength.

name: 04_periodic_boundary
title: 1D pulse with periodic boundaries
notes: Uses 532 nm and dx=lambda/10 from the thesis prose (printed p. 43), rather than the MATLAB draft wavelength.

name: 05_free_space_spectra
title: 1D reflection and transmission in vacuum
notes: Run extended to let the reference pulse leave; left monitor is inside the total-field region and baseline-subtracted. Uses 532 nm and dx=lambda/10 from the thesis prose (printed p. 43), rather than the MATLAB draft wavelength.

name: 06_lossless_two_layers
title: 1D two lossless dielectric layers
notes: Uses the thesis 532 nm rather than the draft 500 nm. 1-R-T is a finite-record spectral residual, not instantaneous stored energy.

name: 07_configurable_layers
title: 1D configurable dielectric stack
notes: Edit the Layer list to set any number of slabs; replaces interactive MATLAB input prompts.

name: 08_ohmic_optical
title: 1D Ohmic loss at optical SI scales
notes: Literal sigma=0.04 S/m at 500 nm gives very weak loss. The original visible attenuation used a later dx=0.01 m override; see experiment 09.

name: 09_ohmic_centimeter
title: 1D Ohmic attenuation on the legacy cm grid
notes: Consistent microwave reinterpretation: dx=1 cm, lambda=20 cm, sigma=0.04 S/m. This is not an optical simulation.

name: 10_integral_loss_0p01
title: 1D integral-current loss, sigma=0.01 S/m
notes: D/E/I conductive model with corrected positive denominator. Consistent cm-grid reinterpretation; original optical labels conflicted with the actual time step. No fitted 70% or 90% loss target.

name: 11_integral_loss_0p004
title: 1D integral-current loss, sigma=0.004 S/m
notes: D/E/I conductive model with corrected positive denominator. Consistent cm-grid reinterpretation; original optical labels conflicted with the actual time step. No fitted 70% or 90% loss target.

name: 12_integral_loss_optical
title: 1D integral-current loss at optical SI scales
notes: Same SI conductivity as Fig. 4-19, with a consistently optical time grid; not a Debye, Drude or Lorentz dispersive model.

name: 13_periodic_dielectric_stack
title: 1D alternating dielectric stack at 5 GHz
notes: Periodic MATERIAL stack, open boundaries. Extended beyond the broken MATLAB 1000-sample source buffer and 3000-step loop to 64000 steps to capture high-Q resonances and delayed transmission; finite-record conservation checked.

name: 14_pec_reflection
title: 1D reflection from actual PEC endpoints

name: 25_single_slit_L25
title: Single slit b=10, detector distance=25 cells
notes: 10 cells per vacuum wavelength; exact PEC obstacle; detector distance measured from the exit face. Periodic x represents repeated apertures and can affect late-time patterns.

name: 26_single_slit_L30
title: Single slit b=10, detector distance=30 cells
notes: 10 cells per vacuum wavelength; exact PEC obstacle; detector distance measured from the exit face. Periodic x represents repeated apertures and can affect late-time patterns.

name: 27_single_slit_far_field
title: Single slit with extended observation region
notes: Extended domain with all-side PML to suppress replicas. Chosen L=300 cells gives full-aperture Fresnel number 0.033; exact L is not specified for Fig. 6-7.

name: 28_double_slit_L5
title: Double slit b=10, gap=10, detector distance=5
notes: Uses caption dimensions. L=15 is not Fraunhofer for the full 30-cell aperture; report full-aperture Fresnel number. Periodic x represents an aperture array.

name: 29_double_slit_L15
title: Double slit b=10, gap=10, detector distance=15
notes: Uses caption dimensions. L=15 is not Fraunhofer for the full 30-cell aperture; report full-aperture Fresnel number. Periodic x represents an aperture array.

name: 30_double_slit_b5_L100
title: Double slit b=5 with a distant detector
notes: Preserves the separate prose case b=5 and L=100; captions specify a different b=10 case.

name: 31_refraction_two_media
title: Refraction from n=1.5 to n=2.1
notes: 532 nm from thesis; 25 vacuum cells/wavelength. Finite phased beam replaces the under-resolved draft source. Angles are measured from +y; epsilon_r=n^2.

name: 32_high_index_reflection
title: Reflection and transmission from n=1.5 to n=4
notes: The specified n=1.5 to n=4 interface only partially reflects. It cannot produce total internal reflection. A separate PEC example supplies the ideal specular mirror.

name: 33_specular_pec_mirror
title: Specular reflection from an ideal PEC mirror
notes: Ideal PEC produces full reflection. This is a correction of the intended ideal-mirror experiment, not a claim that n=4 is a perfect conductor.

name: 34_refraction_three_media
title: Refraction through n=1.5 / 2.5 / 1.5
notes: Three dielectric regions with parallel interfaces; first and last index are equal. Run extended to sample the final region.

name: 35_mur_refraction
title: Glass-air refraction with Mur boundaries
notes: First-order Mur replacement for the draft second-order ABC; no artificial magnetic bulk loss. Positive-index conventional dielectric.

name: 36_diagonal_huygens_array
title: Diagonal array of equal-phase point sources
notes: Source-only prototype: no refraction interface is active in refraccionlarry.m.

name: 37_root_double_slit_700nm
title: Double slit from the root FDTD2D.m
notes: Rotated to +y propagation. Integer sampled legacy intervals correspond to two 2-cell openings and a 5-cell opaque gap despite Ancho=5/Separacion=5. PEC replaces the 5.7e8 S/m obstacle; tiny background loss omitted.

name: 38_waveguide_bend
title: Effective-index waveguide bend
notes: Reconstruction of intended 20 um-radius, 0.775 um-width bend. Includes a scalar eigenmode solver to replace missing ezmode; no claim of exact agreement with the incomplete 3D effective-index prototype.
